findings.summary: Multi-tenant data leakage / cross-tenant cache pollution vulnerability due to omitting tenant in cache key.
findings.suggested_action: Incorporate the tenant into the cache key (e.g., `(tenant, key)`) so tenants cannot access each other's cached values.

limitations: No dynamic execution environment or tools available.

findings.summary: Global unbounded cache dictionary may grow indefinitely, posing an out-of-memory risk over time.
findings.suggested_action: Use a bounded cache mechanism like an LRU cache or time-to-live eviction strategy.

limitations: No memory profile or scale metrics available.
No style configuration or repository guidelines supplied.

findings.summary: Existing unit test verifies cross-tenant isolation and will fail against this implementation; tests covering cache hits and unhashable key scenarios are missing.
findings.suggested_action: Add tests verifying that cached results are returned on subsequent calls for the same tenant and key, and test behavior with distinct tenants and keys.

limitations: Cannot execute test runner to verify test failures dynamically.
